# azion_intelligent_dns_record (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Complete setup with parent DNS zone
# First, create the parent DNS zone
resource "azion_intelligent_dns_zone" "example" {
  zone {
    name   = "example.com"
    active = true
    domain = "example.com"
  }
}

# Then create the DNS record for that zone
resource "azion_intelligent_dns_record" "example_with_parent" {
  zone_id = azion_intelligent_dns_zone.example.id
  record {
    type = "A"
    name = "site"
    rdata = [
      "8.8.8.8"
    ]
    policy      = "weighted"
    weight      = 50
    description = "This is a description"
    ttl         = 20
  }
}

# Example: Using hardcoded zone ID
resource "azion_intelligent_dns_record" "example" {
  zone_id = "12345"
  record {
    type = "A"
    name = "site"
    rdata = [
      "8.8.8.8"
    ]
    policy      = "weighted"
    weight      = 50
    description = "This is a description"
    ttl         = 20
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `zone_id` (String) The zone identifier to target for the resource.

### Optional

- `record` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--record))

### Read-Only

- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of the last Terraform update.

<a id="nestedblock--record"></a>
### Nested Schema for `record`

Required:

- `name` (String) The name of the DNS record.
- `policy` (String) Must be 'simple' or 'weighted'.
- `rdata` (List of String) List of answers replied by DNS Authoritative to that Record.
- `ttl` (Number) Time-to-live defines max-time for packets life in seconds.
- `type` (String) Defines the record type (A, AAAA, ANAME, CNAME, MX, NS, PTR, SRV, TXT, CAA, DS).

Optional:

- `description` (String) Description of the record.
- `weight` (Number) You can only use this field when policy is 'weighted'.

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import azion_intelligent_dns_record.example "12345/67890"
```
